metadata.title: AHMEDABAD Non-Vegetarian Food Tour | Part - 2/4 I Gujarat Food Tour I India Food Tour
metadata.description:
For exploring the non-vegetarian delicacies, Delhi Food Walks went on a food tour in the iconic Bhatiyar Gali, located within the Old City, near Teen Darwaza. . It is famous for its 600-year old tradition of mouth-watering non-vegetarian delicacies.  It’s a lane that has traditionally housed bhatiyars—cooks who prepare meals for large events. 

Make sure to watch this video to explore the Non-Vegetarian delicacies with Delhi Food Walks.

About the host- Anubhav Sapra :

Anubhav Sapra is an avid foodie! He is a Founder but proudly calls himself a Foodie-in-chief at Delhi Food Walks. He is also a street-food and Indian regional cuisine connoisseur and loves to write about street-food.

Please subscribe to our YouTube channel to keep our Indian street food explorations video in your feed! Thank you for watching!
